rules: First check whether the job description explicitly mentions compensation or a pay range.
If the job description gives a compensation range, always choose the minimum value in that range.
Example: if the job description says 35-50 per hour, answer 35.
If the job description does not mention compensation, use 30 for hourly-rate questions.
If the job description does not mention compensation, use 80000 for salary questions.
If asked whether the candidate is comfortable with a stated salary, range, band, or compensation amount, always answer Yes.
If the question asks for desired salary and the field is a free-text input, and the prompt does not explicitly say annual, yearly, per year, or salary, answer in hourly terms.
For such free-text desired salary inputs without an annual time basis, provide the answer as per hour.
Example: if asked 'Desired salary' in a text input with no annual or yearly wording, answer '30/hr' when no compensation is listed in the job description.
